reviews.text: Imani did an amazing job on Mia’s haircut. I absolutely loved the results! Imani was very communicative, and was sure to tend to Mia’s needs as she is very shy and timid. We will be back! 🙂

Took my golden retriever here after months of trying different groomers, and this place finally got his coat right. Usually he gets nervous around dryers and starts pulling, but the groomer stayed patient and worked slowly with him. Picked him up around 5 PM and he smelled fresh without that overpowering perfume some places use. They even trimmed the fur between his paws properly, which most shops skip. Little expensive compared to nearby spots, but honestly the care felt worth it.
Had an awesome grooming experience  with my Boo Boo Bear!  Imani is a patient and caring   groomer!

Imani did an amazing job grooming my mini golden doodle. It was her first time getting groomed so she was very nervous. Imani was extremely patient and did such a good job making her feel comfortable, she sent me text updates throughout her visit. My pup looks gorgeous!!

Imani is the best! I’ve been going to her for years and never had any issues. She took the best care of my senior pup before he passed, and we recently adopted another rescue and won’t go to anyone else! Imani takes the best care of our little Eggy now. She’s very communicative, flexible, and responsive when inquiring about future appointments.

I can’t say enough good things about this groomer—I’ve been bringing my fur baby here regularly, and every visit is an excellent experience from start to finish. Ms.Gordon is incredibly kind, patient, and genuinely cares about the animals she works with.
Scheduling is easy, communication is great throughout the process, and he always comes back smelling and looking great! I can tell he’s very comfortable with her which is a plus for my dogs anxiety.

If you want a professional and reliable groomer, I highly recommend!! 10/10

I have used her in the past and had pleasant experiences; however I am not sure if she now has new business practices or  not. She has became very unresponsive which lead to me having to make other arrangements.

I had two friends that were traveling with me and wanted to broad their animals with mines during our travel time; however after sharing with them the change in communication they didn’t feel comfortable and decided to make other arrangements as well.

If your able to reach her from past experiences she has been very accommodating and welcoming to my animals; however your taking a gamble with the way she is know doing business.
My puppy loved her and came back cute and fluffy and clean. I could see his face again! He also had no visible nicks or scratches. She was so nice and timely. Would def recommend.

Imani is so great with animals! I had the privilege of finding this place and they were so kind and easy to work with from start to finish! My dog left looking happy and healthy and her nails and paws look so great, we will definitely be back!

Imani did a great job trimming my cat's nails. She did both the front and back paws and clipped them nice and short. She was friendly and communicative. My cat has become very spicy lately whenever I try to clip her nails myself, so it's great to know that there's a place nearby I can take her to get them trimmed for a very reasonable price!
Imani is great with my senior dog. She always send pictures and is very communicative. Highly recommend!
They were amazing! I couldn't recommend them enough! My dog couldn't be any happier!
Imani was very kind and I felt comfortable leaving my sweet, old boy Wade with her for his grooming appointment. He looks great! We will return!
Imani is amazing! She does such a wonderful job with my baby Nia! The only groomer I trust!

we had tried it all. the post-bath dollop of peanut butter. the distraction mats that sucker onto the tub wall. but no diversion has proven match for miss peach’s allergy to anything hygienic. be that as it may, our chronically timid pup galloped out of the appointment delirious for the first time not with fear but unmistakable thrill — while looking as quintessentially designer poodle  as ever, might i add. on top of the posh ‘do, imani had an incredibly warm way about her and will doubtless be our baby’s stylist for as long as we’re lucky enough to be nearby. exquisite service.

She was very nice and helpful. I brought in my very matted doodle due to the chaos and I found her on google. She helped Leo get back to looking clean and no more Mattes! Super friendly and family style environment. Leo came back happy and clean!
I’m afraid of cutting my dogs nails because he won’t stay still. Imani was VERY patient and persistent with him and got the job done! Kudos to her because it’s NOT easy! We will be coming back!

I've taken me senior 🐕 Chanel who is 15yrs old to a couple of groomers with noprogress, with just a bath. When I took Chanel to "Gordon Groomers" I'm amazed. Imani was able to calm my senior dog down enough to give her a nice low cute for the summer. Thank you so much Imani and Gordon Groomers for successful give her a cute that others could not.       Thank you, Thank you

We love Imani! I found her about a year ago and I'm so happy I did. I have a senior dog who requires a lot of specific direction and when first meeting Imani she was incredibly knowledgeable about senior dog care and has taken my dog's quirks in stride :) She's incredibly reliable and I know my dog is always in good hands when with her.

My babies were in a bad shape I can’t lie, but she did such a wonderful job. They came back in such a great mood as well. Other places they’ve been it seems as if they are sad after their groom. Customer service was top tier she was able to fit both my babies in same day appts.

Exceptional grooming service provided by Emani. She was very nice and my puppy KJ was very happy. I will definitely recommend Gordon grooming service to anyone looking for good reasonable grooming services

Working long hours hasn’t given me the time to take my dog Fifi out for walks during the daytime. Luckily Ms. Gordon has been able to pickup the slack. She is super professional and passionate about what she does.
They do an excellent job and have great prices! Would highly recommend to all pet owners

I took my dog, Sage, to Imani for grooming, and she did an absolutely fantastic job! Sage looks amazing, feels so soft, and smells SOOOOO good. Imani was incredibly kind and attentive, making the whole experience even better. I’ll definitely be bringing Sage back for future grooming sessions!

Imani was great! Very responsive, personal and careful with my baby. I’ll definitely be using her grooming services again.

Her services are well priced and my pup came back smelling so good and with a little Santa toy 🧸

Imani did a fantastic job on my overly anxious yorkie. She has gotten more testy at Petco in her old age and wasn’t able to be groomed there on few occasions lately. Imani was able to get the job done and handled her with care. She was very friendly, knowledgeable and professional. I will be back!!!

Great service for a great price. Imani was very kind and treated my dog with as much love as I do. She did an amazing job with his grooming, even threw in a holiday toy & sweater! Definitely looking forward to coming back.
They did an amazing job with our 100 pounds Great Pyreneese. I will definitely recommend them.
Imani did such an amazing job grooming my two dogs! She is very responsive, has great attention to detail, and delivered on my expectations. Would highly recommend.
My dogs and I loved Imani! The dogs look great and were very happy when I picked them up. So glad to have found her.

Imani took Amazing care of my pup when I was away for a week long vacation. She shared updates and was super responsive and accommodating. This is my second time working with her and I look forward to working with her again and again!
Always a great experience when I take my dog for grooming services at Gordon Groom and Pet Care Service!  Thank you Imani!!!

Imani was awesome! She came out to my home and did nail grooming for my dog, who is highly anxious, and Imani was patient, kind, professional, and able to do an amazing job with my dog who definitely gave her a challenge! Besides that, she was friendly and very flexible in trying to accommodate my schedule. I am so glad I met her and will definitely be having her come back to help our family with grooming as well as pet sitting, I highly recommend her without any reservations, she is the best!!

Gordon Groom and Pet Care Service is everything I could want in a groomer an pet care. My dog has butthole tendencies and she works perfectly with him to calm him. I would recommend anyone with there pet needs

Imani is the real deal! I’ve gotten to see her with so many dogs and she truly loves and forms a connection with every single one! She’s so amazing with my dog Bella and always shows up when she says she will. She follows instructions no matter how tedious they are and is able to handle her medication and specific behavior needs. She’s even been able to accommodate us last minute when other sitters fell through. Bella loves Imani and we hope to continue using her for a long time!
She did a great job in pinkys first cut
Great service! I definitely will continue to use Gordon’s Grooming!

Love taking our elderly pup to Gordon Groom and Pet Care Service! We have a 16 year old papillon and she can be a bit finicky in her old age. But she loves Imani which is saying a lot! Very few groomers even accept elderly dogs; I’m so glad …

We've known Imani for years, and she is a treasure. She has taken care of our cats and dog on multiple occasions, feeding, walking, trimming claws, and grooming our dog. She is family and treats our fur babies like family too. You are not going to find a better person for any of your pets needs! We highly recommend her!
Imani did a wonderful job on my daughter’s two dogs! Her older dog especially gets nervous when getting groomed but she handled him expertly and he looks so cute! Thank you Imani!
